findings.reason: the renderer belongs in the graph layer (or a neutral, import-free module) so the four graph/llm readers extend their own layer instead of the graph query layer depending on ingestion; the plan should name the owner that keeps the dependency direction.
findings.text: §19 names `imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py` as the owner of the chunk-source renderer, but four of the five call sites that must embed the fragment are in the graph and llm layers (`imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:480` binds `(cc)-[:CODE_EXAMPLE_ID]->(ce)`, `imas_codex/graph/schema_context.py:95` and `imas_codex/llm/server.py:827` join the undeclared `(CodeFile)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(node)`, `imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1649` joins `(ce:CodeExample)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(cc)`); placing the owner in the ingestion package makes every one of those readers import downward across the graph→ingestion boundary, when the established graph-layer Cypher builder beside it is `imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py` and `graph/` already renders relationship predicates

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §19 hides the error-prone part (edge direction plus the source coalesce) behind one renderer in `imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py` that five call sites embed, rather than five hand-written traversals; §14 extends the existing seeder rather than adding a module.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the shared renderer is placed in imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py while four of its five consumers live in the graph and llm layers, inverting the graph→ingestion layering.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 adds no interface family (it adds one `clear_fields` entry and a conditional property clear through the existing seeder) and §19 states its budget ("nothing added") while retiring the phantom `CODE_EXAMPLE_ID` relationship and the two undeclared traversals, so no section adds surface without accounting for it.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 extends the mechanisms it names, `seed_facility_roots` (imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:426, whose `root_paths` parameter and `create_nodes` upsert at imas_codex/graph/client.py:667 `SET n += item` both already exist) and `PATH_RESET_SPECS` (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:240); §19 consolidates the five existing readers it enumerates over the one `HAS_CHUNK` edge whose single writer it names (imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:521, `MERGE (e:CodeExample)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(c)`), and it checks each of the five against the code.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §19 states why the existing builder `imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py` is left unchanged (it is a SEARCH-syntax builder with no join or return) and consolidates instead of forking, so the fragment has a stated justification beyond forwarding.
